verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mailchimp has a drag-and-drop email builder: a hands-on user describes adding a Code module in it. Its pricing page lists custom-coded email templates, and it markets 'Design better emails', so the visual editor and templates exist only as thin mentions. A user also reports a builder quirk where a Code module became unclickable, and a Gmail-clipping help note touches rendering in one client only. Missing for 10: documented reusable or brand template libraries, personalization or merge-tag tokens, cross-client rendering or preview testing, and in-depth first-party editor docs.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: In the drag-and-drop builder I added a Code module with a style tag.
